subject: Audit rights exceptions, pen-test window and evidence handoff (MSA / Order Form)
messages:
From: David Patel <david.p@clearwellhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Nguyen <security@clearwellhealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Clarify security exhibit: SOC 2 assertions + pen-test window + evidence cadence

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Clearwell is excited about the integration. Legal asked me to clarify a few items in the security exhibit / order form before we can route to procurement:

- SOC 2: we need a simple mapping of which SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria Redwood asserts and whether you will provide the full report or a read-only link to the auditor report.
- Pen test access: our security team expects a 30-day notice window and a single 72-hour staging access period for in-scope testing. Can you confirm your preferred window and whether you require an NDA/POA for testers?
- Audit rights: examples in your draft MSA allow inspection; we need specifics on evidence cadence (monthly/quarterly snapshots), how long artifacts are retained, and whether temporary access can be scoped to ephemeral accounts.

I attached a quick template (Clearwell_evidence_template.xlsx) showing the artifact types we typically request. If you can send proposed redline language for the order form (pen-test and audit-rights paragraphs) we can expedite.

Proposed next step: 30-min call with legal + security + your side today or tomorrow to align language. We can be flexible but would like the Order Form to include explicit limits on frequency and retention.

Appreciate it —
David

--
David Patel
Sr. Security Program Manager
Clearwell Health
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: David Patel <david.p@clearwellhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-18T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify security exhibit: SOC 2 assertions + pen-test window + evidence cadence

David — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Karthik (legal) and Markus (assurance) so we can propose concrete language.

Quick answers up front:
- SOC 2: Redwood will provide our most recent SOC 2 Type II report via a secure read-only link to the auditor package. We assert the standard Trust Services Criteria relevant to processing and availability; Markus will confirm the exact assertions and attach the SOC2 assertion spreadsheet.
- Pen test: we can do a 30-day notice window. For the Order Form we generally allow a single 72-hour window per calendar year per customer for full-stage tests, with the option to carve out additional windows by mutual agreement. We require testers to sign our tester NDA and register testers in advance.
- Audit rights / evidence cadence: proposed default is quarterly evidence bundles (snapshots) plus on-demand ad hoc requests scoped to specific incidents; retention for most artifacts is 12 months, some logs are retained 90 days. We can add an ephemeral-access clause that limits access to timeboxed accounts and prohibits persistent accounts.

I attached a first-pass redline (draft_orderform_redlines.docx) with suggested language for: (a) SOC2 delivery (read-only link + responsible contact), (b) pen-test window and registration, and (c) evidence cadence & retention table aligned to your template.

Suggested next steps:
1) Legal quick review of the redline (Karthik).
2) If acceptable, confirm whether Clearwell needs an expanded pen-test window or additional annual windows.
3) If we align, I’ll produce a clean Order Form ready for signature.

Happy to do a 30-min sync today at 3pm PT if that works.

Sofia
--
Sofia Ivanova
Security Partnerships Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-06-18T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify security exhibit: SOC 2 assertions + pen-test window + evidence cadence

Sofia / Markus — I reviewed the draft_orderform_redlines.docx and left inline comments. High level:

- SOC 2: Agree to provide a read-only link to the auditor package. We should gate distribution via a short-term access token and require the external to accept the report terms (no redistribution). I added a sentence to the SOC2 clause about the frequency of refreshed reports (annual) and how we handle requests for historical reports.
- Pen test: The 72-hour window with 30-day notice is reasonable. From a legal perspective we should add: (1) a tester registration requirement including CVAR (tester identity & company); (2) an indemnity carveout limited to negligence; and (3) a requirement that testing be conducted against non-production or agreed staging unless customer gets explicit production access approval. I redlined specific indemnity language that limits our exposure.
- Audit rights / evidence cadence: We should accept quarterly evidence snapshots and on-demand requests for specific incidents, but add an explicit clause limiting the frequency of ad-hoc evidence pulls (e.g., maximum of 6 ad-hoc requests per 12 months) to avoid operational overload. Also propose retention buckets: configuration artifacts (12 months), run-time logs (90 days), KV caches (30 days).

I'll paste the key redline snippets below and attach a copy in the doc with tracked changes. If Clearwell wants a different retention profile, have them propose specific artifacts and we can evaluate.

Karthik
--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Security
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Clarify security exhibit: SOC 2 assertions + pen-test window + evidence cadence

Thanks Karthik — that draft helps. A few clarifications from our side:

- Redistribution: we can accept a read-only link with a non-distribution statement, but our procurement group will also need proof that Redwood’s auditor is independent. Can you provide the auditor name and a brief statement about the scope?
- Pen test: production access is sensitive for us. We can accept staged testing for the 72-hour window; however, we will need the option to petition for a second window in the same year if the initial test identifies significant scope gaps. Is that something Redwood would consider?
- Evidence pulls: limiting ad-hoc requests to six per year sounds reasonable, but we’ll need a process SLA for turnaround (we typically expect 3 business days for acknowledgement and 10 business days for delivery).

Attachment: I filled out your Clearwell_evidence_template.xlsx with the artifacts we care about (attached as Clearwell_SOC2_assertion_list.xlsx).

If you can respond to the auditor question and confirm a two-window option (initial + petition), we’ll route to procurement. Also — please send a DocuSign link once the order form language is agreed; procurement prefers to finish e-signing this week.

David

Agreed items:
- SOC2: Redwood will provide a secure, time‑limited read-only link to the SOC 2 Type II auditor package; auditor: Pine & Ridge LLP (independent). We will refresh the link on annual report publication.
- Pen test: Redwood accepts a 30-day notice and a primary 72‑hour staging window.
